w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE CANCELLATION! You're on your own.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "WAVE 2. The gate opens again. What comes out has seen the corpses and learned nothing, which is worse."
You don't know what that was. The sky, clearing its throat. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ THE CANCELLATION! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
📺 SYSTEM: "COMBAT! THE CANCELLATION! The gamblers lean in. ROUND 1 — FIGHT!"

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: The STAMP descends — slowly, redly. You have time. Use it.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Editor stirs.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: Armor absorbs 3.
Tiger's attack hits you for 7.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
(tiger's hide absorbs 1.)
💪 Your Strength grows — 6. The work is changing you.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: ◈ THE SYSTEM — something shifts in the overlay's weather. It is kin now. The conversation did that.
Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Natalie freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
You work the patch with practiced hands: 3× Wild Ramps (120 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🛡️ Natalie, Miriam, Sal and Gita met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Natalie, Miriam, Sal, Gita are hurt.
The watch holds the wall. You sleep through the worst of it — or would have, if the shouting had let you.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit DEAD PHONE. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Dead Phone.)

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,4. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: Rosa is getting sharper out there with you — steadier hands, better eyes. (Mentor bonus growing.)
✦ Natalie has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)

🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 0 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 77 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (12/8/5), with 4 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 3 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 9 · Craft 10 · Talk 3 · Explore 24) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

◈ OUTSHONE — Jovan Milic did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,062 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
